source: Deep Research specifications audit + checked-in feature backlog
readiness: Unverified Unity build and physical devices; zero human session evidence

features.title: Verified phone builds
features.dependency_notes: Unity license, platform modules, Xcode signing, physical devices.
features.player_visible_outcome: Launch and finish the campaign on a compact Android and an iPhone; respect safe areas, back navigation and resume.
features.stop_or_rollback: Build failure, device blocker or missing Unity evidence

features.title: First 60-second complete loop
features.player_visible_outcome: Start at dry creek with obvious first tile; first rotations extend water; first solve visibly revives a village detail.
features.stop_or_rollback: First action is delayed or first-puzzle comprehension regresses

features.title: Consequence-first visual reveal
features.player_visible_outcome: After tree/bridge/meadow selection, frame and highlight the changed landscape before one brief NPC response.
features.stop_or_rollback: Consequence recall does not improve after two iterations

features.title: Puzzle solver and difficulty metadata
features.player_visible_outcome: Store solution proof, minimum rotations, error traps, hint path, ecological rule, target band and observed solve times per board.
features.stop_or_rollback: Any authored board loses unique solution or observed difficulty spikes unexplained

features.title: Progressive non-punitive hints
features.player_visible_outcome: Stage 1 highlights a useful region; stage 2 names a tile; stage 3 performs one correct rotation; no penalty/currency.
features.stop_or_rollback: Hint reveals unwanted solutions or becomes misleading

features.title: Correct complex-script text rendering
features.dependency_notes: UI architecture decision, licensed font assets, native reviewers.
features.player_visible_outcome: Use Unity Advanced Text Generator/UI Toolkit or a tested equivalent for all player-facing dynamic text, bidi and shaping.
features.stop_or_rollback: Any enabled script renders broken glyphs or uncontrolled overflow

features.title: Large, forgiving touch and readable text
features.player_visible_outcome: One-tap rotation; minimum frequent-action hit areas 44pt iOS/48dp Android; visible pressed state; scalable text.
features.stop_or_rollback: Targets remain inaccessible or mis-taps block play

features.title: Recoverable saves under interruption and corruption
features.player_visible_outcome: Write validated snapshots, recover previous valid save, migrate v1/v2, confirm destructive reset.
features.stop_or_rollback: Previously valid progress is irrecoverable after interruption

features.title: Offline/privacy binary verification
features.dependency_notes: Release build, dependency review, privacy policy.
features.player_visible_outcome: Full campaign works in airplane mode; no ad/analytics SDK; session notes exist only after consent and export only on request.
features.stop_or_rollback: Unexplained network transmission or undeclared collection

features.title: Native-certified launch locale subset
features.player_visible_outcome: Enable only locales passing translation, shaping, native editorial and screenshot QA; retain draft files in repo.
features.stop_or_rollback: An enabled locale lacks native/technical/store signoff

features.title: Non-color connectivity and contrast
features.player_visible_outcome: Use pipe shape, port outline, water movement/pattern and labels in addition to color; provide high-contrast mode.
features.stop_or_rollback: Flow or protected state is indistinguishable without hue

features.title: Subtle audio feedback and ambience
features.dependency_notes: EG-001, audio assets and mobile testing.
features.player_visible_outcome: Add quiet rotation/water/success cues and state-dependent ambience; muted by default until preference, with independent mute.
features.stop_or_rollback: Sound distracts, annoys or is required to understand play

features.title: Optional haptic response
features.player_visible_outcome: Light tick per valid rotation and distinct completion pulse; easy toggle and OS respect.
features.stop_or_rollback: Haptics reduce accessibility or have no measurable touch benefit

features.title: Causal journal
features.player_visible_outcome: For each choice show Choice → World effect → NPC memory → Next-puzzle effect; all derived from saved events.
features.stop_or_rollback: Journal invents causes or players ignore it

features.title: Three-depth authored consequences
features.dependency_notes: EG-003 and authored narrative/choice-consequence matrix; EG-105 is a downstream optional extension, not a prerequisite.
features.player_visible_outcome: Every major choice has immediate visual, later puzzle/systemic and chapter-ending consequences, authored and deterministic.
features.stop_or_rollback: Delayed effects fail causal recognition or contradict history

features.title: Bounded NPC memory tokens
features.player_visible_outcome: Mira/Orin/Fen reference at most 3–5 salient real choice events each; no chat-history illusion.
features.stop_or_rollback: NPC remembers unmade events or dialogue adds no player value

features.title: Distinct character values and voices
features.player_visible_outcome: Mira favors habitat, Orin practical access, Fen community/beauty; each responds honestly without a morality meter.
features.stop_or_rollback: Characters are interchangeable or constrain choices

features.title: Ecological constraints change reasoning
features.player_visible_outcome: Roots restrict rotations, bridge creates a meaningful crossing, meadow protects fragile routes; constraints interact in later puzzles.
features.stop_or_rollback: Extra ecology rules reduce comprehension or are merely board rotation

features.title: Recombine learned mechanics
features.player_visible_outcome: Final third combines two or three previously taught ecology constraints with readable previews.
features.stop_or_rollback: Combined rules create unteachable difficulty or unfair solutions

features.title: Transparent difficulty choice
features.player_visible_outcome: Offer Gentle / Standard / Thoughtful; optionally ask about a calmer board after repeated hints; never silently change difficulty.
features.stop_or_rollback: Mode switching corrupts state or increases confusion

features.title: Optional return stream
features.player_visible_outcome: Offer an optional short authored/verified stream accessible anytime; no streak, calendar lock, expiration or penalty.
features.stop_or_rollback: Return feature requires streaks or no one voluntarily reopens

features.title: Meaningfully different new garden
features.player_visible_outcome: After ending, begin an alternate authored ecological route with different puzzle and consequence combinations.
features.stop_or_rollback: Replay differs only cosmetically or reduces first-run quality

features.title: Solver-assisted human authoring tool
features.player_visible_outcome: Offline generator proposes candidates; exact solver checks uniqueness/rotation cost; human approves and themes every shipped board.
features.stop_or_rollback: Generated puzzles bypass human review or unique-solution proof

features.title: Ten-step undo history
features.player_visible_outcome: Undo up to ten tile rotations; keep choice reconsideration as a separate, explicit action.
features.stop_or_rollback: Expanded undo corrupts saves or loses valid history

features.title: Large-board focus mode
features.player_visible_outcome: Offer 1.25×/1.5× board, thicker channels, clear focus; pan only if necessary.
features.stop_or_rollback: Board zoom hides controls or adds mis-taps

features.title: Screen-reader puzzle semantics
features.dependency_notes: UI/text migration, semantic control adapter, device QA.
features.player_visible_outcome: Expose tile coordinates, ports, rotation state, connected/leak status, action labels and journal meaning to VoiceOver/TalkBack.
features.stop_or_rollback: Screen reader cannot complete first three boards

features.title: Comprehensive reduced motion
features.player_visible_outcome: One reduced-motion preference disables nonessential camera drift, butterflies, water shimmer and transitions without hiding game state.
features.stop_or_rollback: Reduced motion hides causal effects or still causes discomfort

features.title: Local world postcard
features.player_visible_outcome: Show optional still image plus one truthful sentence about today's world change, stored locally.
features.stop_or_rollback: Postcard misstates world or distracts from completion

features.title: Consequence-driven ending comparison
features.player_visible_outcome: Show 'the village you made' with three major choice consequences, optionally compare alternate possible paths without moral score.
features.stop_or_rollback: Epilogue describes choices the player did not make

features.title: Small authored world micro-events
features.player_visible_outcome: Trigger visitor, repaired bench, bird or shade gathering from exact state combinations; no clock-based chores.
features.stop_or_rollback: Micro-events invent time or become chores

features.title: Cosmetic seasonal palette
features.player_visible_outcome: Optional local palette change without real-world time gate or seasonal exclusives.
features.stop_or_rollback: Seasonal color harms contrast or gates content

features.title: Explicit offline share card
features.player_visible_outcome: Generate local image of the player's real village and use OS share sheet only on explicit tap.
features.stop_or_rollback: Sharing is automatic, identifiable or unwanted

features.title: Accessible first-run presets
features.player_visible_outcome: Optional Calm / Large Text / High Contrast quick preset, skippable and editable later.
features.stop_or_rollback: Presets delay first input or are irreversible

features.title: One-time chapter expansion support
features.dependency_notes: Store billing, pricing tests, content pipeline.
features.player_visible_outcome: Offer optional substantial new authored chapter packs after the base experience; offline access once entitled.
features.stop_or_rollback: Purchase dependency breaks offline base or requires paid hints

features.title: Localized store screenshots
features.player_visible_outcome: Localize the first three causal-loop screenshots for each launch-certified market.
features.stop_or_rollback: Localized screenshots are misleading or uncertified

features.title: ASO positioning experiments
features.player_visible_outcome: Test truthful 'water puzzle', 'cozy offline', and 'choices change village' creative/metadata variants via store-supported experiments.
features.stop_or_rollback: Traffic is too small for a credible test or creative is misleading

features.title: Tablet/PC expansion after mobile proof
features.player_visible_outcome: Adapt layout/input only after a mobile product/price/retention threshold is met.
features.stop_or_rollback: Porting consumes resources before mobile product proof
